conditions, times, current, applies, supersedes_record_ids. evidence is a nonempty EvidenceRef
array. record_ids and supersedes_record_ids are arrays of supplied numeric record IDs.

or unknown allows reviewing actual current assertions, not treating the question as its answer.

not only an old fact marked current=no. Questions, hypotheses, plans and reported assertions

conditions, times, current, applies, supersedes_record_ids. evidence is a nonempty EvidenceRef
array. record_ids and supersedes_record_ids are arrays of supplied numeric record IDs.

particular record. Evidence in another fact does not satisfy this rule. If supersedes_record_ids

statement need not be verbatim, but must preserve negation, uncertainty and restrictions.
polarity is affirm, negate or unknown, independent of uncertainty. strength is null or the

compute is null for lookup/list or when no justified computation can be supplied. Otherwise it

Speaking of which, I'm curious to know if there's a way to see which posts are performing well and which ones aren't. Do you know if Instagram Insights can help me with that? And by the way, I've got 1250 followers on Instagram now, so it'd be great to get some insights on how to optimize my content for them.
What are some tips for creating engaging captions for my posts?
I'm actually thinking of trying out Instagram Live more often. Do you have any tips on how to make my live streams more engaging and interactive?
I'm thinking of doing a Q&A session on my next live stream. Do you have any tips on how to make it more engaging and interactive? For example, how can I encourage viewers to ask questions?

I'm looking to create a new Instagram post about a recent industry event I attended. Can you help me come up with a catchy caption that will encourage engagement, considering my audience is mostly from the US, UK, and Australia? By the way, I've been meaning to check my current follower count - I think I'm close to 1300 now.
source_snapshot.text: I like the options! For Option 1, can you modify the hashtags to make them more specific to my niche, like #contentcreation or #digitalmarketing, instead of the general #industryevent?

history: I'm looking to optimize my Instagram content strategy, can you give me some tips on how to increase engagement and grow my audience?

I've been doing some of these already, like posting regularly and using a consistent aesthetic. It's great to know I'm on the right track. Speaking of which, I'm curious to know if there's a way to see which posts are performing well and which ones aren't. Do you know if Instagram Insights can help me with that? And by the way, I've got 1250 followers on Instagram now, so it'd be great to get some insights on how to optimize my content for them.
What are some tips for creating engaging captions for my posts?
I'm actually thinking of trying out Instagram Live more often. Do you have any tips on how to make my live streams more engaging and interactive?
I'm thinking of doing a Q&A session on my next live stream. Do you have any tips on how to make it more engaging and interactive? For example, how can I encourage viewers to ask questions?

I'm looking to create a new Instagram post about a recent industry event I attended. Can you help me come up with a catchy caption that will encourage engagement, considering my audience is mostly from the US, UK, and Australia? By the way, I've been meaning to check my current follower count - I think I'm close to 1300 now.
I like the options! For Option 1, can you modify the hashtags to make them more specific to my niche, like #contentcreation or #digitalmarketing, instead of the general #industryevent?
Can you suggest some relevant influencers or content creators in my niche that I could collaborate with, considering my recent growth and engagement on social media?
I think I'll start with micro-influencers and see how it goes. Can you suggest some potential collaboration ideas for me to reach out to them?
